clue.text: Rough handling that is deliberate is being covered up

indicators.note: the word is is wrapped inside the synonym for deliberate, so it ends up covered

parts.note: to deliberate is to ponder or muse
taken as written

explanation.surface: A complaint that someone's rough treatment was intentional and is now being hushed up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deliberate' reads as an adjective on the handling, but it is the verb meaning to ponder.
explanation.definitionFit: Improper or rough treatment of something is a synonym for abuse of it.

clue.text: Periodical not gross — something that can be attractive

parts.note: a magazine, shortened to mag
net is the amount after deductions, the opposite of gross

explanation.surface: A magazine that is not vulgar may still prove appealing.
explanation.definitionFit: A magnet literally attracts iron, so a playful paraphrase of the device.

clue.text: Pots he was getting knocked out in a factory of exploitation

indicators.note: the letters of the three words are knocked out of shape and rearranged

explanation.surface: A potter whose pots get hammered flat in a grim workshop.
explanation.definitionFit: A workplace where labourers toil long hours for poor pay is the classic exploitative factory.

clue.text: Singer to get some ladies in a trance

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A crooner so smooth that some women swoon into a trance.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition 'Singer to get' swept in the link 'to get'; the definition is 'Singer' alone, and 'to get' joins it to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Frank Sinatra was the famous American crooner and vocalist.

clue.text: Notice project worker, one assisting senior officer

parts.note: an advertisement, or ad, is a notice
to project is to stick out, or jut
a worker ant, the crossword's usual worker

explanation.surface: A notice about a project worker who helps out a senior officer.
explanation.definitionFit: An army officer who acts as administrative assistant to a commanding officer holds this title.

clue.text: Put off skimpy attire, good person who has a resigned outlook?

parts.note: to put off is to discourage or deter
a mini is a very short skirt or dress
a saint, abbreviated St

explanation.surface: Someone discouraged from wearing skimpy clothes, a virtuous soul resigned to fate.
explanation.walkthrough: St is the standard abbreviation for saint, a 'good person'; the definition is the rest of the clue, with the question mark for its loose fit.
explanation.definitionFit: One holding that every event is fixed in advance tends to accept fate with resignation.

clue.text: Nut is left only half fixed — tool needed

indicators.note: fixed in the sense of repaired or rearranged, so the letters are reordered
only the first half of the word left is used, its first two letters

explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen implement or instrument is a synonym for a tool.

clue.text: Tree person once on the council. man made redundant

indicators.note: the word man is dismissed from the longer word, as a worker is laid off

parts.note: an alderman was a senior council member in Britain until the office was largely abolished
taken as written

explanation.surface: A former councillor laid off from his job, with a tree in the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A deciduous tree of the birch family growing in damp ground.

clue.text: Winds coming up? Get some warm clothes

definitions.meaning: rising currents of warm air, which gliders and birds ride
insulating long underwear worn in cold weather

explanation.surface: Chilly winds rising, so put on something warm.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both rising warm air currents and heat-retaining undergarments.

clue.text: Healthy food for party people

definitions.meaning: leafy green vegetables such as cabbage and kale
members of the environmentalist Green Party

explanation.surface: What wholesome food to serve to guests at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Leafy vegetables, and members of an ecological political party, both go by this plural.

clue.text: One present late in the morning or evening by river

parts.words: late in the morning or evening
parts.note: at ten o'clock, either fairly late in the morning or in the evening
the Dee, a river in Wales, England and Scotland

explanation.surface: Someone showing up late in the day beside a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is present at a meeting or event is said to be taking part as a guest.

clue.text: Vehicle, say, in City area — area half destroyed

indicators.note: the word for say goes inside the City postcode

parts.note: EC, the postcode of the City of London
to say is to state

indicators.note: half of the word area is destroyed, leaving its first two letters

explanation.definitionFit: A car with a long body and rear door for luggage, known in America as a station wagon.

clue.text: Unusual chasm, a ravine that needs special card to gain access

definitions.text: that needs special card to gain access

explanation.definitionFit: An ATM dispensing money only works once a bank card is inserted.

clue.text: Street with strange sort of sound

parts.note: rum is old British slang for odd or strange

explanation.surface: An odd noise heard out in the street.
explanation.definitionFit: Brushing the strings of a guitar produces this casual chordal noise.

clue.text: Leaders won't stay in position — expect people to get sacked

definitions.meaning: read literally, the tops of bodies will tumble off
an idiom warning that people will be punished or dismissed

explanation.surface: A warning that the bosses will be ousted and staff fired.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom predicts dismissals; taken literally it pictures beheadings, so leaders literally lose position.

clue.text: Prayer bringing love with hurt and fear dissipating

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

indicators.note: the letters of the two words scatter and reform

explanation.surface: Someone praying to bring love while hurt and fear fade away.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lord's Prayer is known by its opening words addressing God.

clue.text: Steer clear of workers in special trousers

parts.note: to skip something is to avoid it
ants are the crossword's stock workers

explanation.surface: Avoiding the workmen in their fancy trousers.
explanation.definitionFit: Insulated waterproof trousers designed for wearing on the slopes.

clue.text: Church leader like me will get involved with psalter

indicators.note: the words like me are mixed in with psalter, and the combined letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A church figure boasting that someone like him will take up the psalm book.
explanation.definitionFit: A German title for the director of a chapel choir or orchestra, as Bach was.

clue.text: Girl with big dictionary getting tied up somehow

parts.note: lass is a girl, especially in Scotland and northern England
the OED, the Oxford English Dictionary in many volumes

explanation.surface: A girl buried in a hefty dictionary, getting herself in knots.
explanation.definitionFit: Roping a steer with a looped rope is one particular way of tying it.

clue.text: Sailor to loiter, having lost heart in historical region

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor

indicators.note: the word loses its central letter, as if its heart were removed

parts.note: to tarry is to linger or loiter

explanation.surface: A dispirited seaman hanging about in a historic land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having lost heart' removes the middle R of TARRY, leaving TARY.
explanation.definitionFit: The old name for the vast central Asian lands ruled by Tatar peoples.

clue.text: Conservative fails and goes out of business

parts.note: to lose is to fail, as in a contest

explanation.surface: A Tory who flops and the firm goes bust.
explanation.definitionFit: A shop or firm shutting down permanently ceases trading.

clue.text: Nuisances in religious instruction thrown out by clergy

indicators.note: the letters for religious instruction are ejected from the clergy word

parts.note: priests make up the clergy
RI, religious instruction, a British school subject

explanation.surface: Pesky nuisances in a scripture lesson expelled by the clergy.
explanation.walkthrough: RI was the old British school name for religious education.
explanation.definitionFit: Annoying people or vermin are both commonly called by this plural.

clue.text: Thus America presents one of its composers

parts.note: so means thus, in that way
USA, the United States of America

explanation.surface: This is how America showcases one of its composers.
explanation.definitionFit: John Philip Sousa, the American march king, wrote The Stars and Stripes Forever.

clue.text: You finally react with law being broken and howl

only the final letter of the word you is taken

clue.text: Obsessional state that could make us nosier

indicators.note: the letters could be rearranged to make something new

explanation.surface: An obsessive condition that might make us more inquisitive.

clue.text: Ways to hide love — such will evoke sadness

indicators.note: the routes conceal the letter for love inside them

parts.note: paths are ways or routes
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.definitionFit: The quality in art or writing that arouses pity or sorrow is named here.

clue.text: More than one drink that is brought by deck worker aboard ship

indicators.note: the pieces go inside the ship letters, as if on board

parts.note: SS, steamship
a deckhand, shortened to hand
ie, id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A round of drinks brought by a sailor on deck aboard ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Beer mixed with lemonade, in the plural for several glasses.

clue.text: Island's tree featured in speech

indicators.note: the word is spoken and the sound written another way

parts.note: the cypress, a tall conifer

explanation.surface: An island's distinctive tree, mentioned in a speech.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mediterranean nation on an isle south of Turkey.
